subject: Adding control variables to RI-CLPM decreases R²

messages.author: 81b10f678dc301a6
messages.subject: Adding control variables to RI-CLPM decreases R²
parts:
Dear all, I am running RI-CLPM which is basically the one described here, only with 3 points in time: https://jeroendmulder.github.io/RI-CLPM/lavaan.html I then proceed to add time-constant control variables as such:

  x1 + x2 + x3 ~ cont1 + cont2
  y1 + y2 + y3 ~ cont1 + cont2

This works fine but what surprised me is that the R² values of the wx and wy components decreases after adding the controls (by a sizeable amount). Is this expected? How can this be explained? In a normal regression model, adding more controls can only increase R².
